headlines.title: 정부, 첫 거시재정금융간담회 개최 … 중동전쟁 대응 공조 강화
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 재정·금융·세제 정책 수단 최적 조합 모색 거시당국, 정례회의 통해 정책 공조 강화 "예산·세제·금융·외환, 최적 정책조합 논의" 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 1일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 거시재정 금융간담회에서 발언하고 있다. 왼쪽부터 박홍근 기획예산처 장관, 구윤철 부총리, 이억원 금융위원장.

headlines.title: 정부, WGBI 편입 대응 ' 상시점검·투자유치 추진단' 가동
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 외국인 자금 유입 동향 점검…금융위·한은 등 관계기관 참여 투자 애로 해소·IR 강화로 국채시장 경쟁력 제고 추진 연합뉴스 정부가 세계국채지수(WGBI) 편입 개시에 맞춰 외국인 자금 유입 점검과 투자 유치 강화를 위한 전담 조직을 본격 가동했다.

headlines.title: RIA 복귀금액, 美 주식 보관액 0.1 %
headlines.summary: 3.8만계좌 2439억 유입…환율 안정효과 미미 100% 세금공제 혜택 주는 5월까지 지켜봐야 이란 전쟁 여파로 고환율에 비상이 걸리면서 국내시장 복귀계좌(RIA) 출시 효과에도 관심이 쏠린다. 계좌 출시 목적 자체가 환율 안정 기여에 있기 때문이다. 초반에 계좌 개설은 점차 늘고 있지만, 그에 비해 실제 유입된 자금 규모는 미비한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 재경부, 민관합동 수출 플러스 지원단 출범 … 8개 부처 참여

headlines.title: 결국 LPG도 인상 앞으로 더 오른다
headlines.summary: 프로판 50원 부탄 29.2원↑ 인상요인 절반도 반영 안돼 추가 상승 가능성 커져 국제 액화석유가스(LPG) 가격과 환율 상승 영향이 누적되면서 4월 국내 LPG 가격이 인상됐다. 그러나 실제 인상폭은 그동안 누적된 인상 요인의 일부만 반영된 수준에 그쳤다. 미반영된 원가 부담과 추가 상승 요인이 겹치며 향후 가격 인상 압력도 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 남는 게 없다 ”… 매출원가율 90%대 건설사 ‘ 3중고 ’ 비상
headlines.summary: 7개 상장 대형사 작년 원가율 90.4% 이란전쟁탓 자잿값·운송비 상방 압력 사업 위축, 선별 수주·수의 계약 확대 국내 건설업계가 중동전쟁 영향으로 고환율·고유가·고금리 악재를 맞닥뜨리며 신규 주택 정비사업 동력이 위축될 수 있다는 우려가 나오고 있다. 사진은 서울 시내 한 아파트 건설 현장에서 작업자들이 작업을 하고 있는 모습.

headlines.title: ‘ 다주택자 돈줄 끊는다’… 17일부터 주담대 만기연장 불허
headlines.summary: 수도권·규제지역 아파트 대상 임대 계약 땐 종료일까지 예외 연합뉴스 정부가 오는 17일부터 다주택자가 보유한 수도권·규제지역 아파트 대상 주택담보대출의 만기 연장을 원칙적으로 허용하지 않기로 했다. 금융권 대출이 다주택자의 투기적 주택 수요를 떠받치는 수단으로 활용되지 않게 하기 위해서다.

headlines.title: 이 대통령 지시 36일 만에 … 사상 첫 농지 전수조사

key_headlines.title: Government Holds First Macro-Fiscal-Financial Meeting, Boosts Middle East War Preparedness
key_headlines.summary: The government convened its first macro-fiscal-financial meeting, bringing together key economic ministers to strengthen policy coordination and prepare proactively for potential long-term impacts of the Middle East conflict.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Task Force for WGBI Inclusion to Monitor Capital Inflows and Attract Investment
key_headlines.summary: A dedicated task force has been activated by the government to continuously monitor foreign capital inflows and enhance investment attraction efforts in response to Korea's inclusion in the World Government Bond Index (WGBI).

key_headlines.title: WGBI Inclusion Expected to Act as 'Oasis' Amidst High Exchange Rates
key_headlines.summary: Expectations are high that Korea's inclusion in the WGBI will attract up to 80 trillion won in foreign capital, stimulating demand for the Korean won and potentially stabilizing high exchange rates.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Surges, Won Strengthens on Hopes of Middle East Conflict Resolution
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI index experienced a significant rebound, and the won appreciated sharply, driven by expectations of an early resolution to the Middle East conflict and anticipated foreign capital inflows from WGBI inclusion.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's top economic officials, including Vice Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul, held their inaugural macro-fiscal-financial meeting to address economic stability amid global uncertainties. A key focus was managing the won's volatility, with Koo warning against excessive depreciation disconnected from fundamentals and highlighting the role of WGBI inclusion in stabilization. The government also launched a specialized task force to monitor foreign capital flows and attract investment following WGBI entry, which is anticipated to bring substantial foreign funds and help stabilize exchange rates. Market sentiment improved significantly on hopes of an end to the Middle East conflict, leading to a strong rebound in the KOSPI and appreciation of the won.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell indicated that current monetary policy is well-positioned to observe the impact of the Iran conflict. South Korea's exports reached a record-high $86.13 billion in March, but concerns are growing over the economy's heavy reliance on semiconductors, which account for 38% of total exports. The government also raised its oil crisis alert level to 'caution' and President Yoon Suk-yeol reviewed inflation and energy supply/demand. Additionally, financial authorities announced plans to manage household debt growth within 1.5% and reduce the household debt-to-GDP ratio to 80% by 2030, down from the current 89.4%.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic financial markets saw a strong rally, with the KOSPI jumping over 8% and the won appreciating by 29 KRW against the dollar, driven by growing expectations of an end to the Middle East conflict. This rebound ended a four-day losing streak for KOSPI, marking its fifth-largest daily gain. Hopes for foreign capital inflow due to Korea's inclusion in the World Government Bond Index (WGBI) also contributed to rising bond prices and a stronger won. However, market volatility is expected to continue given the ongoing geopolitical uncertainties and the potential for international oil price fluctuations. Amid the market's recent sharp declines, high-dividend ETFs have emerged as a refuge for individual investors.
sections.Industry & Technology: Researchers have developed next-generation battery technology capable of fully charging an electric vehicle in just 12 minutes, significantly improving charging speeds. Kia unveiled its 2027 All-New Seltos and the EV3 electric vehicle at the New York International Auto Show, with the EV3 boasting a 10-80% charge time of 29 minutes. Meanwhile, SK Group's battery businesses, including SK On, are reportedly facing a period of financial losses and struggles, becoming a 'painful finger' for Chairman Chey Tae-won. Despite challenges like declining EV demand and increased competition from China, Korean battery companies are securing multi-billion-dollar contracts, particularly in anode materials, and focusing on price competitiveness.
sections.Real Estate: New government regulations, effective April 17, will prohibit multi-homeowners from extending apartment-backed loans in Seoul and regulated areas, sparking concerns about the ripple effect on the rental market. Experts predict this could lead to a reduction in jeonse (deposit-based lease) supply and increased housing costs for tenants. This measure is part of a broader strategy by financial authorities to manage household debt, aiming to lower the household debt-to-GDP ratio to 80% by 2030 from the current 89.4%. The move is expected to cool the Seoul and capital area apartment markets and could potentially trigger 'reverse jeonse' incidents as 'gap investment' properties hit the market.
sections.International Economy: US Vice President JD Vance is reportedly pressuring mediating nations to accelerate a peace agreement with Iran, warning of intensified infrastructure pressure if Iran does not cooperate. Meanwhile, former President Donald Trump stated his intention to reduce tariffs on imported steel and aluminum finished products from 50% to 25%. French President Emmanuel Macron indirectly criticized the Trump administration's unpredictability during his visit to Japan, highlighting Europe's more predictable stance. Markets are now anticipating that the Federal Reserve is highly unlikely to cut interest rates by July 2025, largely due to the impact of the Iran conflict. Trump also expressed dissatisfaction with allies like South Korea for not contributing to efforts in the Persian Gulf amid the Middle East crisis.
sections.AI & Economy: A recent KPMG report highlights that Artificial Intelligence is evolving from merely a productivity tool into a 'profit engine,' rapidly reshaping various industries and market structures. OpenAI, despite securing a record-breaking $122 billion in investment, now valued at $825 billion, faces the challenge of proving profitability. The company needs to justify its astronomical infrastructure investments amidst intense competition in the AI sector while maintaining its leading position.
sections.Others: Mirae Asset Securities is accelerating its 'Mirae Asset 3.0' strategy, integrating digital and wealth management services to expand its client base through diverse investment content, including global strategies, real estate, and ETFs.
